tagline: Route, resolve, and evidence every case
hero: A precision command center for consumer banking requests, incidents, controls, and auditable closure.

customerNeed.title: Customer need
customerNeed.description: Describe the account access, onboarding, payment, dispute, branch, or digital issue.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Mobile app, web, branch, contact center, ATM, or cross-channel.

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.description: Routine, time-sensitive, suspected fraud, regulatory complaint, or active incident.

knownDetails.title: Known details
knownDetails.description: Include dates, transaction amounts, error messages, case IDs, and what has already been tried.

welcome.message: Start with the customer or incident context. I will route it to the right banking manager, apply controls, and drive closure.
